propositions: Runtime marker files (*/.archived, */.write.lock) are tracked in the tickets branch HEAD but should be ignored, causing git status to show dirty state and plan-review attestations to fail with store-read-failure.

An ensure unit must idempotently remove tracked marker files from git index via git rm --cached without deleting worktree copies, then self-heal missing markers in the reader by re-materializing them when compiled state indicates archived status.
After the ensure unit runs, peers merging the untrack commit must have their worktree marker files deleted by git merge cleanly, with git status remaining clean and no marker churn visible.

The reader in reducer/_api.py must detect when a net-archived ticket lacks its .archived marker file and re-materialize it via write_marker, scoped only to exclude-archived list paths to preserve include-archived behavior.
